verdict.rationale: Embedding a UI framework into an existing server-rendered page is a fair axis for Svelte, but the evidence never documents it. Nothing shows mounting components into an element of an existing page or progressively enhancing server-rendered HTML. What the pack does cover is adjacent: compiling to DOM-updating JavaScript, standalone Vite builds to a dist folder, SvelteKit's own server rendering, and prerendering components to HTML strings.
